data.content_ref: inline:The problem 061ddfcce3bb contradicts SRC_003's claim that the distinction between genuine reliability and compliance is a category error; it proposes that this distinction is empirically detectable via perturbation or divergence-convergence patterns. This relation is refuted if no observable difference in outcome or process exists between a purely compliant panel and a genuinely reliable agent when faced with an edge-case perturbation.
